correctness.rationale: For n≥3, verified P(C_n)=conv{e_i+e_{i+1}} inside Δ(2,n), unnormalized ℓ2. Applied projection criterion r·u_k ≤ r·p for all k. δ=1 gives0; n4 opposite chord projects to (1/2)1 squared distance1. For n≥5 two-step chords use weights (1/3,1/6,1/6,1/3), residual +1/2 at targets and −1/3 at three other vertices giving 5/6 and maximum active edge dot 1/6. For n≥6 δ≥3 use four incident edges weight1/4, residual +1/2 targets and −1/4 at four neighbors giving 3/4. Counts n,n,n(n−5)/2; strict residual variance excludes all nonvertex farthest points. Fresh independent support inequalities exhaustively verified for every chord through n=45 (15,179 unordered pairs), not extrapolated for general n.

value.rationale: Exact complete chord-distance shells of the canonical unsigned cycle edge polytope quantify robust approximation of a hypersimplex by its natural sparse graph subpolytope. The sharp n4 exceptional boundary, stabilizing distance 5/6 from n5, explicit projection points and unique extremal locus are motivated metric geometry, not just arbitrary small graph table values; the proof is short but the exact all-size invariant is independently useful.

limitations: Ambient unnormalized ℓ2 metric only; n≥6 second shell gap holds at vertices only, not all continuous points.
Unindexed metric-projection equivalent theorem remains possible historical priority risk.
